Create a single landscape 1120:800-ratio overhead 2D game screenshot ART DIRECTION COMP, not a poster or asset sheet. Contemporary cohesive anime cel illustration: crisp dark coloured contours, broad clean colour masses, 2-3 tone shadows, subdued cool teal/slate stone floor and warm ivory/brass/orange accents, no photoreal scratches. Simple empty industrial fantasy boss arena with quiet floor tiles and minimal peripheral walls, no rubble. Top dark slim HUD showing small orange player HP bar left and a centered boss health bar underneath; bottom dark HUD pistol and small abilities. No portrait inset, no large captions or concept labels. Camera is orthographic top-down, horizontal edges horizontal, not isometric.
Player at screen (650,430), a SMALL 60px tall chibi female adventurer at equivalent1120x800 resolution: huge head, very short torso and limbs, brown ponytail, teal brass goggles, ivory/teal outfit and small pistol. Preserve modern moe cuteness. NEVER make her taller or long-legged. Boss left at (340,370), body footprint about200px wide and170px tall, roughly3 player heights, plenty of visible combat floor around both. One restrained orange cannon shot and small steam puff, not giant obscuring effects. All objects and character painted in the same line/shadow language. Design a NEW alternative to the old bell-shaped foundry spinner but retain combat affordances: radial lower gunports for all-direction salvo, one clearly identifiable powerful main cannon, readable furnace core, believable mechanism for a fast charge and a slam/shockwave. Machine must look like a formidable workshop guardian, not friendly toy. No humanoid arms, no hand weapons. Main cannon points right toward open floor, player aiming at boss. DESIGN A: squat rounded pressure-furnace boiler, broad barrel-shaped body with softly beveled ivory enamel armor plates and dark brass bands, two short steam chimneys behind, a prominent single central orange furnace viewing slit, stout rectangular side cannon, ring of six thick gunports around low base, very short mostly hidden drive rollers beneath. More round and readable than original but heavy; little rivet clutter; no face eyes or mouth. Lower shell and pressure seams clearly articulated.
